import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric, handling commas
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    
    # Convert flipper_length_mm from text to numeric, handling negative values
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    
    # Fix negative flipper_length_mm values (likely data entry errors)
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170, 'flipper_length_mm'] = df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170, 'flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    
    # Fix sex label variant: 'female ' -> 'female'
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip()
    
    # Drop rows where body_mass_g is out of range (2500-6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    # Drop rows where flipper_length_mm is out of range (170-235)
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    
    # Keep penguin_id column
    return df


def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and calculate average body mass
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    
    # Return as dict with group labels as keys
    return result
